George Town (Cayman Islands).note: 911 is the single emergency number for police, fire, and ambulance across the Cayman Islands.

Bruges.note: 112 is the Europe-wide emergency number connecting to ambulance, fire and police, free from any phone.

New York City.reason: Tourist areas are safe; use caution in some subway stations late at night. High-crime areas lie outside tourist zones.

Sevilla.reason: Pickpocketing/bag-snatching around the cathedral, Santa Cruz and on transit

Thessaloníki.reason: Pickpocketing on transit; caution around the station and west of the centre at night

Marrakesh.reason: Aggressive touts and scams in the medina and main square (henna, fake guides, snake charmers); pickpocketing in crowds.

Panamá.reason: Avoid El Chorrillo, Curundú and parts of Santa Ana; caution at the edges of Casco Viejo at night

Köln.reason: Caution around the Hauptbahnhof and Ebertplatz at night; pickpocketing at crowded sites/carnival

Antwerpen.reason: Caution around Antwerpen-Centraal and the De Coninckplein station district at night

Male.reason: Resort islands very safe; on Malé dress modestly and don’t drink alcohol in public (Islamic law); petty theft

Zanzibar.reason: Petty theft; caution walking alone at night on beaches; dress modestly (conservative Muslim island)

Göteborg.reason: Some outer districts affected by gang violence; central/tourist areas safe

Acapulco de Juárez.reason: High cartel violence (Guerrero); stick to the Diamante/tourist zone, avoid outskirts and travel after dark

Xi’an.reason: Pickpocketing around the Bell Tower, Muslim Quarter and station

Pattaya.reason: Nightlife scams, padded bar bills, drink-spiking and bag-snatching; jet-ski damage scams on the beach
